verdict.rationale: A community report says Brave's free-tier Terms of Use explicitly prohibit using API responses for AI inference, and another commenter notes a separate AI-inference plan. That points to a documented permitted-use policy, but the pack contains no first-party policy text. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of permitted-use terms, any stated robots.txt crawling stance, content licensing/rights terms for returned results and snippets, and storage/redistribution rules.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can read a documented stance on robots.txt, content licensing, and permitted use of results

citations.quote: the free tier's Terms of Use prohibit using responses for AI inference
